sources.quote: QS-C-2025,SUP-C,conditional,2025-04-01,,PER-BIANCHI,QS-C-2023,no new parts until 8D-25-031 is closed and re-audit passed
4.3 A supplier with status conditional may not receive new parts.

findings.why: Meccanica Chisone has been conditional since 2025-04-01, and QS-C-2025 replaces the earlier approved status. BR-225 would be a new part for it, so it may not receive it.

sources.quote: 4.2 A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The approved supplier list covers BR-225 and its only approval is for SUP-B. There is no approval for SUP-C for BR-225, PLT-BEI and CUST-AUR. The ASL does cover this part, so the missing entry means SUP-C is not approved. The BR-180 and BR-310 approvals for SUP-C do not extend to BR-225.

sources.quote: The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts after any of: a change of source
Approval is granted per part number and per manufacturing site. An approval for one part does not extend to another part, even if made of the same material.

findings.why: BR-225 belongs to PRG-X, which is an Aurelia program. Revision 4 of the manual replaces revision 3. A change of source needs written Aurelia approval (PPAP) and 90 days' notice before implementation. Nothing in force covers it, and an approval for BR-220 or BR-180 does not carry over.

sources.quote: Supplier: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C). Opened 2025-03-20. Status: open.
cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material delivered by

findings.why: SUP-C has an open 8D on EN AW-6082 material. The drawing material for BR-225 is EN AW-6082-T6, an alloy temper of ALY-6082. The root cause is still under investigation and the corrective action is not verified.

sources.quote: SC-BR225-YS,BR-225,Yield strength Rp0.2 at least 250 MPa,250

findings.why: The drawing requires MAT-6082-T6. SUP-C is qualified only for MAT-6061-T6 and MAT-6082-T5, and has no capability for 6082-T6. The T5 temper has a typical yield of 230 MPa, below the 250 MPa minimum of SC-BR225-YS.

sources.quote: 4.4 A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for the drawing material. Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: There is no 3.1 certificate on file for SUP-C for MAT-6082-T6. Owner: the supplier quality engineer (Elena Gallo).
